name: Disallow Privileged Containers
benchmark: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8 / FedRAMP High AC-6
description: Privileged containers share all capabilities of the host kernel and must be blocked in production.

name: Require Read-Only Root Filesystem
benchmark: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark v1.8 / FedRAMP High SI-4
description: Containers must run with read-only root filesystems to prevent runtime binary tampering.

name: Disallow Root User Execution
benchmark: FedRAMP Rev 5 High / NIST SP 800-53 AC-2
description: Containers must specify runAsNonRoot: true to enforce non-privileged execution context.

name: CCCS ITSG-33 Sovereign Boundary Isolation
benchmark: CCCS ITSG-33 PBMM / SC-7 Boundary Protection
description: Enforce network boundary isolation and egress restriction policies for Protected B workloads.
